signals.usability_note: Clear daytime view of a two-story residential frontage. A large tree in the foreground partially obscures the facade and roof.

professional_landscaping.evidence: Trimmed, rounded shrubs line the foundation and the lawn is neat, but nothing shows a crew or equipment, so this is likely homeowner-maintained.

signals.notes: Well-kept brick and siding colonial with a white SUV in the asphalt driveway; the tree canopy hides much of the roof, so roof condition is only partly assessable.
